text:
Alex: Heads up — ACME partner asked us to freeze driver/CUDA/ROCm versions for their marketplace image before their joint announcement next Tuesday. They want a signed matrix and a rollback plan.
Maria: Got it. Do they require CUDA 12.3 or is 12.2 still ok?
Alex: They said '12.x certified' but called out a specific perf regression on 12.3 in internal notes. Asking us to recommend a pinned combo.
Zheng: We saw a perf delta on A100 with 12.3 + driver 535 on long sequences. Repro script attached in thread. Short answer: 12.2 + driver 520 is the most stable for our infra.
Sam: @Zheng can you paste the minimal repro + expected metric drop? Need something partners can run.
Zheng: Sure — snippet:```bash
# repro loop
python perf_test.py --model gpt-j --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 100
# observed: latency +18% on 12.3/535 vs 12.2/520
```
Nina: Partner compliance wants a signed "compatibility matrix" PDF and a one-page hotfix playbook (what to do if reg hits production). Can we produce both by EOD Friday?
Maria: EOD Friday is tight but doable if we split tasks. I can draft matrix + comms text. @Alex can you own verification checklist with infra?
Alex: I can run a quick canary across our staging and Dedicated pools today. Will ping OpsBot to kick the jobs.
OpsBot: Canary job triggered: canary-run-4991234567 on pools (staging,dedicated). ETA ~45m. Logs -> https://redwood.ci/canaries/4991234567
Sam: I'll prepare the rollback steps and the kernel/driver pin commands we recommend. Proposal: pin drivers to 520.x and CUDA to 12.2, with an opt-in 12.3 path flagged as experimental.
Zheng: +1. Also add a telemetry hook: if p50 latency increases >10% for 5m, auto-fallback to 12.2/520 image. We have a rollout script we can adapt.
Maria: I'll assemble deliverables: 1) compatibility matrix PDF 2) one-page hotfix playbook 3) partner-facing comms blurb. Draft by Friday 5pm PT.
Alex: Canary finished: Quick pass — no regression on our staging clusters for 12.2/520. 12.3/535 shows the perf delta as expected. Logs in canary link.
Nina: Great — partner asked also for a nightly smoke plan for the week after announcement. Can we commit to 7-day post-GA monitoring?
Sam: Yes — we can schedule 30m daily smoke runs and a daily digest. I'll add ops runbook entries.
Maria: Action items: Maria -> drafts PDFs + blurb (due Fri EOD); Alex -> full verification checklist + canary results (today); Sam -> rollback/runbook + daily smoke schedule (tomorrow); Zheng -> attach repro and telemetry thresholds (today). Nina -> coordinate partner comms and confirm acceptance.
Alex: assigning owners in the doc now. Please @mention me when you update so I can sign off.
Nina: I'll confirm with ACME that the proposed pin (CUDA 12.2, driver 520.x) is acceptable and report back. :thumbsup:
Maria: One more note — include exact image tags we will publish (example): `redwood/runtime:cuda12.2-driver520-rc1` so partners can pin the same.
Zheng: Also include a short FAQ item: "Why not 12.3?" with the perf link and mitigation.
Sam: If partner wants hotfix cadence, propose a 48-72h emergency window for driver hotpatches with our partner PMs looped.
Nina: OK. I'll loop partner PM + legal for signoff once docs are ready. Thanks everyone.
Alex: Thanks — let’s reconvene if partner pushes for 12.3. Otherwise we ship the matrix and playbook.
Nina: Closing loop — I'll post partner signoff when received.
